default_rule: A workflow not explicitly listed as CURRENT or CURRENT_COMPATIBLE is not permitted in the live .github/workflows namespace.

live_workflows.purpose: One small stdlib-Python cross-repository authority/registry/runtime health check. AIOC has no repository-attached self-hosted runner; this exception is not an application, package, release, or feature completion gate.

cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc.retired_workflow_policy: All pre-CRS AIOC workflows remain HISTORICAL_INERT in Git history. None may be restored without explicit lifecycle registration and current-assumption review.
cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc.hosted_exception_boundary: The AIOC health workflow may use stock GitHub-hosted Linux only for bounded governance health validation. It must not become a substitute for the self-hosted application/package final-validation policy.

live_workflows.purpose: Shared self-hosted Linux/Windows exact-head validation, compact diagnostics, deterministic receipts and comparator for thin production profiles.
Manual Windows runner availability/toolchain smoke; never a feature completion gate.

cybalicistjt-stack/Multiversal-app.retired_workflow_policy: A2, DT proof, GATX, IA, P9-06, Repository Solidity, Salvage, Stage-A, VCH proof and paused feature-specific workflows remain HISTORICAL_INERT in Git history. Resumed feature work must use a new thin Validation Core profile or a documented current capability exception.
